_comment: The one hand-maintained list of the board's captains. Adding a captain here
is the whole edit: bin/fm-dashboard.sh (jq), server/store.py (json) and
web/app.js (fetch) all read THIS file at runtime, and nothing else lists
them. It lives under web/ so the browser gets it over the static path the
server already serves - no new route, no build step, no dependency.
Order is display order. 'short' is the CLI shorthand; for firstmate it is
the id itself. 'color' is the pill/chip color, applied inline from here,
which is why styles.css has no per-captain rule to keep in step.
